{{Quote|Rad Flat, Rad Flat, this is Cartann Bladedrome. Congratulations on four stops. Ar apologies far the inconvenience.|Cartann Bladedrome officer to Wedge Antilles|<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>}}
The '''Cartann Bladedrome''' was one of two military bases close to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cartann City|Cartann]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]]. It was here where [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]] and the other [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] conducted their duels with the [[Adumari]] pilots.<ref name="soa" />
